name: @taste-and-see/nest-outbox-consumer
description: Shared NestJS outbox-consumer SDK for the Taste & See platform (TS-142-followup-2). Consumer side of the outbox pattern (PDD §7.3 / CLAUDE.md §5.3). Subscribes to Redis Streams via XREADGROUP against a per-service consumer group; hands each entry to a typed handler; XACKs on success; tracks consumer-side dedup against an event_id table; retries on transient failure; dead-letters after a configurable cap. Phase-1 wire format matches @taste-and-see/worker-outbox-relay; the Phase-3 Kafka swap (per PDD §29.1) replaces the RedisStreamConsumer without touching handler or scheduler shape.
